sourceComparison.comparisonMethod: Read both complete UTF-8 sources, apply only the listed literal replacements to each old source, and compare the resulting full string case-sensitively with each new source. Read-only SHA-256 and length checks identify the reviewed files.

sourceControlsReviewed: Exact settled-main commit, successful exact-source Foundation, successful hosted preparation, one queued owner job and only its run-specific label are checked before registration.
Retained archive, all three exact members, receipt, two native ARM64 binaries, compiler identity and official runner listener are checked against explicit reviewed identities.
An existing Bonsai, model, speech or runner process, existing runner credential or preexisting repository runner registration rejects admission without stopping that user session.
An independent watchdog observes the same externally supplied monotonic clock; intake, runtime-only provisioning, registration, model work, cleanup and retention retain their original deadlines.
Cleanup targets recorded PID plus creation-time identities and this wrapper's unique registration; registration secrets remain environment-only and raw native/token-bearing output is suppressed.
knownUnchangedLimitations: Some trusted API and process-output bounds are checked after ReadToEndAsync; this review does not claim strict preallocation bounds for those trusted intake paths.
Synchronous hashing/provisioning operations rely on outer ownership/watchdog controls rather than immediate cooperative preemption.
Pretrial source review proves no live admission, model execution, completion, isolation, cleanup or promotion gate. Actual retained receipts and independent execution review are still required.
